def select_next_node(graph, unvisited_nodes):
    eps = 1e-9
    
    pre = graph.graph.get('precomputed', {})
    max_core_k = pre.get('max_core_k', 1)
    
    degrees = [graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    clusterings = [graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    cores = [graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    betws = [graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    eigs = [graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    
    max_core = max(cores) if cores else max_core_k if max_core_k > 0 else 1
    
    best_score = -float('inf')
    best_node = None
    
    for n, clust, core, betw, eig in zip(unvisited_nodes, clusterings, cores, betws, eigs):
        # Avoid division by zero in eig
        eig_adj = eig + eps
        
        # Local redundancy inverse (1 - clustering)
        inv_clust = 1 - clust
        
        # Ratio betweenness / eigenvector centrality (bridging over hub)
        bridge_ratio = betw / eig_adj
        
        # Scale core number logarithmically to moderate effect
        core_factor = (core / max_core) if core > 0 else 0
        core_scale = core_factor * (1 + (core_factor / (core_factor + 0.5)))
        
        # Combined score multiplicatively, emphasizing bridge_ratio and core_scale, attenuated by local clustering
        score = (inv_clust + eps) * bridge_ratio * core_scale
        
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_node = n
            
    return best_node
